summary: Interactive tool negotiation prefetch causing repeated RPC round-trips and e2e latency spikes
description:
Issue summary:
Customers using on-demand tool/function calling with schema validation report intermittent high tail latency and request timeouts. The request path shows the platform performing an on-demand schema negotiation and optimistic prefetch for tool metadata which triggers multiple RPCs to the function-proxy and scheduler before token streaming begins.

Impact:
- Affected a subset of dedicated customers (Streamly) since 2026-03-09 with intermittent 2–8s tail spikes and occasional 30s+ timeouts for streamed responses.
- Client visibility: elevated 5xx and downstream application timeouts. SDK retries amplify load.

Environment:
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) in prod-us-east (us-east-1)
impact: Streamly saw ~6% of LLM generation requests hit >2s tail latency and ~0.6% timeouts (30s). This correlates with sessions that trigger tool discovery/prefetch flows.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use SDK with function-calling enabled and unset schema cache in the client (simulate cold-start).
2) Send burst of streaming chat requests referencing a newly-registered tool that requires schema validation.
3) Observe request traces in tracing UI: repeated gRPC calls from api-gateway -> function-proxy to fetch schema/metadata before token stream starts.
4) Repeat with schema cached on client: latency returns to baseline.
logs:
Excerpt of trace (trimmed):
- 2026-03-11T14:12:03Z api-gateway requestId=abc123: start -> call function-proxy /resolve-tool (100ms) -> function-proxy -> scheduler /fetch-schema (220ms) -> function-proxy /validate-schema (150ms) -> api-gateway start-stream (total prefetch=480ms) -> serving-runtime first-token delayed (2.1s total).
- SDK retry burst: client retried after 1.0s, causing duplicate prefetch calls and increasing observed tail latency.
comments: 2026-03-10 Nina Patel: Customer reported elevated timeouts after enabling function calling for a new external tool. They first saw this during a production rollout of their conversational agent.

2026-03-10 Marco Ruiz: Reproduced locally using a mock tool that returns schema metadata. Observed two sequential RPCs to scheduler during the preflight path; looks like an optimistic prefetch handshake followed by an explicit schema validation call.

2026-03-11 SRE (Liu Chen): Added temporary metric on function-proxy to count prefetch vs validation RPCs. Noted spike correlated with client cold-cache windows and SDK retries. Created dashboard panel comparing requests with/without schema-cache hit.

2026-03-12 Engineering (Aisha Gomez): Hypothesis: the function-proxy client code path makes an optimistic metadata fetch, then unconditionally validates schema in a second call; should only validate when metadata differs. Preparing PR to short-circuit second call when tight TTL is present.
2026-03-13 Marco Ruiz: Deployed canary patch to staging: short-circuiting validation reduces preflight RPCs by ~65% and median e2e pre-token time from 520ms -> 170ms in synthetic test.
workaround: Advise customer to enable client-side schema caching (SDK option 'toolSchemaCacheTtl') and increase initial request timeout to avoid triggering immediate retries. For immediate relief, disable automatic prefetch by setting 'toolPrefetch=false' in per-tenant config.
resolution: In Progress - mitigation deployed to staging; change under review for production rollout. Follow-up: implement idempotent prefetch RPC and add server-side dedupe of concurrent prefetch requests.
notes: Investigative runbook: compare per-request RPC counts and trace preflight durations; correlate with SDK retry rates. Priority to land PR that avoids unconditional second validation call. Consider back-pressure on SDK retries to prevent amplification.
